pining_and_tension: looked away a second too late
memorized the shape of his laugh
kept finding excuses to sit closer
the air between them felt charged
tension you could have struck a match on
wanting him was background noise by now
it was getting harder to pretend
three years of not saying it
proximity_and_almosts: close enough to feel the warmth of him
close enough to count his freckles
knees knocked together and neither moved away
shoulders pressed together on the couch
the space between their hands felt deliberate
almost — and then the phone rang
if either of them leaned in, that would be it
they both pulled back at the same time, laughing nervously
charged_eye_contact: held his gaze a beat too long
looked at him like he was the only thing in the room
looked at him the way you look at something you can't have
glanced at his mouth and back up
a whole conversation in one look
his eyes asked the question first
looked at him like he already knew the answer
first_touch: tucked a strand of hair behind his ear
rested a hand at the small of his back
touched his jaw, tilted it up
pulled him in by the sleeve
hands found each other in the dark
the touch said what neither of them could
kissing: a kiss soft enough to break your heart
a kiss that started careful and forgot to stay that way
kissed the corner of his mouth first
pressed a kiss to his forehead
kissed his knuckles, one by one
pulled back just far enough to breathe
went back for a second one before the first had ended
tasted like cherry slurpee and courage
